question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you like the poker game?
Have you ever been in a long distance relationship?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What was all that about?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Watch the curb! `Watch the curb!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Watch the curb! [color=#3b78e2][i]Watch the curb![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt pulls back onto the freeway.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Did you get what you needed?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I had to find this Alexei guy... Not that it was easy given the security! That place is under lockdown!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What did you need Alexei for?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For this sweet fake ID!
Colt holds up a fake Centerscore University ID with his picture on it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'Domingo Florentine'? Your false name is 'Domingo Florentine'? What, was Fakey McFakerson taken?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Domingo Florentine is an awesome name!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do you need a fake school ID for, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Something tells me it's not to sneak into advanced classes...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Har har. Don't you two worry your little heads about it, okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That is an excellent question. Let me just get my wallet...
Brendan reaches into his pocket... Then sprints off!

nodes.speaker: Stern Man
nodes.text: Hey! Come back here at once!
Brendan sprints through the campus, hops the fence, and dives into the car where Colt and Denni are waiting!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where did you go?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It doesn't matter! Drive, drive, drive!
Colt slams on the gas! The car speeds off as the stern man runs out and glares...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I am... John.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: John Johnson.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I am a student here.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I am good at playing the clarinet.

nodes.speaker: Stern Man
nodes.text: Well, John Johnson, let's see your student ID.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... The funny thing is... I left my ID... In my other... Clarinet?

nodes.speaker: Stern Man
nodes.text: Not having an ID is a breach of Student Body directive 437, punishable by two weeks detention...

nodes.speaker: Stern Man
nodes.text: That is... If you even are a Wilson High student...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... I... Well... The funny thing is... Look over there!
The stern man doesn't blink. Brendan sprints off, diving over a fence and into the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Stern Man
nodes.text: Hmmmm...
Back in the hearse, Colt and Denni sit impatiently... When the back door flies open, and Brendan dives in!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where did you go?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It doesn't matter! Drive, drive, drive!
Colt slams on the gas! The car speeds off...
Brendan glances out the window.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Where the heck is Colt? I don't have time for this!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll be right back.
Brendan hops out of the car and walks onto the Wilson campus.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh. That's weird.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's just so... Quiet out. Wilson is usually loud and boisterous with people causing trouble and pulling pranks...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But now it's totally empty... And totally silent.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It looks like everyone is in their classrooms, working quietly... `Everyone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It looks like everyone is in their classrooms, working quietly... [color=#e23b3b][i]Everyone![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Suddenly, a hand grabs Brendan's shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You have to go! Get out of here! Now!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Go! Before he... Oh no! He's here!
Steve runs off. Brendan turns to follow... And bumps into a tall, stern man!

nodes.speaker: Stern Man
nodes.text: And who might you be, young man?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, I... I'm really sorry. I didn't realize that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, it's kind of why I'm going up there. I need to see her... To talk it over in person and see what's really going on.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The last time I was there, she couldn't stop talking about you... I can't imagine what happened.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. I can't either.
Denni reaches over and pats Brendan's hand.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's okay. I'll help you figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You will?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah. I might not know much about relationships, but I do know girls. If something's going on with Dinah, maybe I can help you understand it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really? That's so awesome!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, I... I guess it is...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Seriously, it's impressive. I don't think I could `ever` do a long distance relationship...
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously, it's impressive. I don't think I could [color=#3b78e2][i]ever[/i][/color] do a long distance relationship...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They're, uh, not that bad...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you kidding? All the drama and the tension and the calling back and forth...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's sure unpleasant...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not to mention worrying if they're cheating on you...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, fine, Dinah broke up with me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I didn't realize that... I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure. Drive safely. Under the speed limit.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Give or take 25 miles per hour.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So we're all agreed then! Let's meet at Denni's house in an hour!
An hour later, Brendan and Colt stroll up to Denni's house, where she's waiting in the driveway...
In front of a vintage hearse!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, now `that` is pretty sweet...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, now [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] is pretty sweet...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I feel like this is a bad omen...
And soon enough, the three of them are in the car, roaring down the freeway....

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah. Listen to that engine growl!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's growling because you're driving 100 miles an hour! That's not a `good` growl! Slow down!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's growling because you're driving 100 miles an hour! That's not a [color=#3b78e2][i]good[/i][/color] growl! Slow down!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, live a little, munchkin!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Would you at least stop swerving? I get that you've got a death wish, but I'd like to live until at least graduation...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, look on the bright side! If we die, we won't have to switch cars!
Colt abruptly veers off an exit and pulls into Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, Colt? What are we doing here? This isn't CSU...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know, I know, but I have to run a quick errand. Just sit tight.
Colt hops out of the car, leaving Brendan and Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I am really starting to dislike that guy...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He's something else...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So. You're dating Dinah, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, yeah. She is my sister's roommate.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh! Right!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She seems like a cool girl. Everything going well with you two?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.prompt: Everything going well with you two?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Everything going well with you two?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And what could possibly make you sure of that? Have you even met Colt before today?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... No, not really... But he's got that 'good driver' look, doesn't he?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The chiseled jaw... The steely gaze... The fine layer of stubble...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're just describing his facial features.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I am a pretty handsome dude...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, Colt, will you promise to drive safely and under the speed limit?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now you're on her side, Pocket Protector?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just put yourself in her place. You've got quite a reputation as this high-octane, daredevil, car-racey-guy...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Guilty as charged...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But for the purposes of this trip, and for Denni's peace of mind, I think you can put that aside and be a nice, responsible driver.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I... I guess I can do that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So you promise to drive safely and under the speed limit?
Brendan slumps down on the floor.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I can't believe it, guys. She actually broke up with me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Could it be some kind of miscommunication?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Read the text, dogg. It's unambiguous.
Hector pats Brendan on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, kid. You just got dumped. Nothing to do but take it like a champ.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! I'm not accepting it! I'm not letting our relationship end... Not like this!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm going to Centerscore U. to find Dinah, and I'm going to get to the bottom of exactly what's going on!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...You guys wanna give me a ride tomorrow to Centerscore U.?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Any other night, man, I would, but $ZOE and I have a dinner reservation at 'The Oceanside Obelisk'. You know how hard that place is to get into...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And Amanda and I are going with them. Double date. Kinda awkward now... Given the conversation...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why don't you try the Student Help Ads, Brendan? Linda used them once to get a ride to a concert...
And so, the next day, Brendan is at school, posting his request on the Student Help Ads board...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Need a ride, eh?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Gah! How did you read that so fast?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've got a keen eye for opportunity. What's a bookworm like you want at CSU, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's... It's my girlfriend. I need to find out why she's breaking up with me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, that just warms the cold chambers of my heart. I'll give you a ride. Free of charge.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thing is... You need to supply the car. My bike's in the shop, and besides, the guy limit on it is one...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I don't have a car. Or a license. And there's no way my Dad will let me borrow his...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Excuse me? I couldn't help but overhear. Are you guys taking a trip to Centerscore University? Because I'd love to tag along.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's been ages since I've visited my sister!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We'd love your company, tiny hipster, but we're kind of short a car.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I have the keys to my sister's old car. She left it for me for when I'm old enough to drive.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is perfect! We've got a car, a driver, and a nerdy guy tagging along!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait a minute, aren't you the guy who crashed a limo? I don't know if I trust you with my sister's car...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, so I crash `one` limo and suddenly, I got a reputation as a bad driver?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, so I crash [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] limo and suddenly, I got a reputation as a bad driver?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Yes?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen, princess, I was winning street races while you were still polishing apples in middle school. Don't criticize my driving!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And your history of participating in illegal street races is meant to reassure me... How?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Both of you, stop arguing!

options.label: I'm sure Colt's a good driver.
Denni is right to be worried.

nodes.text: Brendan dials Dinah's number...
Ring...
Ring...
Ring...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Hi! You've reached Dinah. I can't come to the phone right now, so, um, please leave a message, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Beep!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: See? See? She didn't answer! She `always` used to answer my calls!
nodes.text_bbcode: See? See? She didn't answer! She [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] used to answer my calls!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No. I... I can't do that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If I call her, then she's just going to confirm the break up, and it'll be `real`... And I can't handle that conversation over the phone.
nodes.text_bbcode: If I call her, then she's just going to confirm the break up, and it'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color]... And I can't handle that conversation over the phone.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He's got a point, Howard. I don't know if I can handle watching him cry.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... After Dinah graduated last year and went to Centerscore University, we kept up the long distance thing, and it was going pretty well...
We'd talk every day on the phone...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I love you! No, I love you `more!` No, I love you `the most!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I love you! No, I love you [color=#e23b3b][i]more![/i][/color] No, I love you [color=#e23b3b][i]the most![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hee hee!
She visited me at Centerscore and came to the dance...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: ...My heart belongs to you.
We even played the latest Warscrewdriver expansion, 'Metal of Otters!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, Dinah! We need to figure out a way to protect the Lutrine Kingdom from the Sea Lion King!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, I don't see why we have to save a bunch of stupid otter pirates in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Brendan, I don't care about the details of your increasingly silly game. Get to the breakup!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Lately, she's been more and more distant. We haven't been able to talk every day... In fact, we were barely able to talk all of this week!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Then we had the whole trust issue fight with her getting mono...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And now today... I got this text!
Brendan hands Howard his phone with trembling hands.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'we shld c otr ppl'... We should see other people.
A leaden silence hangs over the room.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wow. Just... Wow. Dinah always was an odd egg, but I never saw her as the kind of girl that dumps a dude via text...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This really doesn't seem like her. Maybe you should call and see what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can snap at me all you want, that doesn't make me any less right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, Hector. Now isn't the time. Brendan, tell us what happened with Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm always correct. That's why they call me 'Hecto Correcto'.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No one calls you that! Brendan, tell me what happened with Dinah.
Brendan very carefully goes through the room, looking at Dinah's desk, her bed, her closet...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A phone number on a napkin...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A pair of corduroy pants...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And the helm of a medieval suit of armor...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! Dinah's dumped me for a pantless nerd!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll admit it's not looking great.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And I haven't even made back any of Colt's money!

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do?

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do?

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Then let's play!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: We'll each draw a card and hold it up to our foreheads without looking at it. That way, I can see your card, and you can see mine...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But we can't see our `own` cards.
nodes.text_bbcode: But we can't see our [color=#e23b3b][i]own[/i][/color] cards.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Exactly. We'll each put an ante of 10 dollars into the pot, then take turns going first.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: The person who's first can either make a bet or fold. If they fold, the other player automatically wins the pot.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: If they bet, then the person who's second can fold, match the bet, or double the bet.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: If the second person folds, the first person wins the pot.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: If they match the bet, we show our cards, and the higher card wins.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And if they raise the bet, the first player has one last opportunity to fold or match the bet.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Got that?
The two of them walk into the frat's den...
Where a high stakes game of poker is going on!
Seated at a table in the middle of the room is Tina...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Come on, you pansy! Make a bet!
Chuck...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Okay, okay! I'm all in!
And Domingo Florentine!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Too rich for my blood, cowpokes. I fold.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is Colt wearing... A fake mustache?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes. Yes he is.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Read 'em and weep, Chuck!
Tina flips over her hand. She has three-of-a-kind to Chuck's pair of sevens!

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: I read them! I'm weeping! Aaaaaaaah!
Chuck slides all of his chips over to Tina's pile!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pardon me, li'l cowgirl. Can I have a small break?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Whatever.
Colt gets up and runs over to Brendan. He speaks in an urgent whisper!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Brendan! Buddy! You have to help me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What's going on? Where's Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, the real reason I came to CSU was to play in this poker game I heard about...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I figured, I can win easy! How hard is it to hustle college guys, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I suppose...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thing is, the college guys aren't the problem! The problem is... `Her!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Thing is, the college guys aren't the problem! The problem is... [color=#e23b3b][i]Her![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt points a trembling finger at Tina. She picks at her teeth with a toothpick.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She's hot and smart and `really good at poker!` She's killing me!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's hot and smart and [color=#e23b3b][i]really good at poker![/i][/color] She's killing me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm still not seeing where I come in...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's perfect! You're totally hung up on your girlfriend, so you'll be immune to her feminine wiles!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did you seriously just say 'feminine wiles'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I bought into the game for $400 and I have $300 left. If you can get in there and win back at least $50, I'll tell you where your girlfriend is.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Colt, even if I knew how to play poker... And even if I thought I could win...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How am I supposed to just take your place at the table?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've got just the solution.
A moment later, Brendan slides up to the table...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why hello, er, cowgirl...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Nice 'stache. Who are you supposed to be?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why, I am Domingo Florentine's brother... Rodrigo Florentine! We're practically interchangeable!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Right. Look, I'm bored and have to go get ready for a party tonight. Let's just get this over with.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I say we play some high stakes Blind Man's Bluff. Would you like to know the rules?

nodes.prompt: Would you like to know the rules?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Would you like to know the rules?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Sorry, buddy. There's no one here by that name.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm, I could've sworn that was it... Hold one moment, I can remember it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Was it Dormitory Flowershop?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, he's got brown hair, and he's super shady.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Domingo Florentine! Why didn't you say so? Go on in!
Brendan and Denni head in.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Aren't you nerds supposed to have good memories?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I didn't have time to make a catchy mnemonic!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh yeah. Domingo said his crew would be rolling through. Go on in.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I would be delighted to, good sir.
Denni rolls her eyes and follows Brendan in.

Brendan and Denni head in.

nodes.speaker: Brendan

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah.
Brendan frantically runs through the room, throwing things in all directions!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Where?! Where are these other people? Where are they `hiding?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Where?! Where are these other people? Where are they [color=#e23b3b][i]hiding?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Brendan! Calm down! You're making a huge mess!
Brendan opens Dinah's drawer and dumps all of her clothes on the floor!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A-ha! Clothes! That proves it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Proves `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Proves [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That... She... Owns clothes?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, okay, you're officially losing it. Come on.
Denni grabs Brendan and drags him out of the dorm.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I suppose I kind of lost it back there.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're telling me! If Dinah hasn't already dumped you, she probably will once she sees what you did to her room!
The college guy approaches...
And he smile and waves!

nodes.speaker: Adam

nodes.text: One night, Hector and Howard are hanging out late at Hector's house...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not going to answer that, Hector, because it's stupid!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, it's a legitimate question! Would you rather never make out with $ZOE again, or make out with Travis once?
Suddenly, the door flies open! Brendan runs in!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Guys! Guys! It's an emergency!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Comic shop run out of model spaceships?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm serious! I... I think Dinah just broke up with me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? What are you talking about? I thought you guys were doing great!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I told you. What did I tell you? Long distance relationships `never work!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I told you. What did I tell you? Long distance relationships [color=#e23b3b][i]never work![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Want to catch up? Check out The New Girl Mega Pack to meet $ZOE! Or grab the Season Sets, now available in our store for up to 50% off!

Suddenly, the door flies open! Brendan runs in!

nodes.text: Guys! Guys! It's an emergency!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Comic shop run out of model spaceships?

nodes.speaker: Brendan

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? What are you talking about? I thought you guys were doing great!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I told you. What did I tell you? Long distance relationships `never work!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I told you. What did I tell you? Long distance relationships [color=#e23b3b][i]never work![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: At least I've made back some of Colt's money...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A lot better than Brendan's poker skills! What was that about?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I never said I was good at poker!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The point is, he did his best. Now are you going to tell us where Dinah is?
Dinah steps forward and gives Brendan a big kiss!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm so happy you could be here!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, I... I think it's sweet that you came here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just wish I could say the same for Brendan's poker skills!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, at least I won back `some` of your money...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, at least I won back [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] of your money...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now it's time for your side of the deal. Where's Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... You didn't pick up when I called!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I was just too busy setting up the Ren Faire!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What about the stuff I saw in your room? The phone number, the helmet, and the pants?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The phone number was for a mutton distributor... And the pants and helmet were so I could make you a costume!
Begging your pardon, milord or lady, but that makes this a perfect game! Enjoy your bonus scene!
A little while later, at the far end of the Renaissance Faire...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Prithee, milady, would you care for a bite of my leg of lamb?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I shall pass, milord, for the lamb is quite greasy, but I shall give you a kiss on the cheek for being the handsomest lord in the land!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ah! A kiss from a lady as beautiful as thee! Truly, I am blessed!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Nay, milord, it is I who am blessed, for a lord as handsome as thee!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Would you two just get a room?!
And in Raven's room...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: No way! He did `not` use 'Domingo Florentine' as his fake name!
nodes.text_bbcode: No way! He did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] use 'Domingo Florentine' as his fake name!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He did!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And I thought I was bad using 'Sylvia Yamaguchi'!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Isn't it ridiculous? He's just the most reckless, irresponsible, crazy guy I have ever met!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Awww... Does little sis have a crush?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Eww! Not in a million years!
And finally, at a party in the OMG sorority, Tina is lounging around when...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey there, good-looking.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, well, well. If it isn't Mustache Mike or whatever your name is. Did you know I had to wait at the police station for three hours?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, I can't begin to understand or explain what happened at that poker game. I've dealt with that cop before... He's pretty much nuts.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hmm...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I can point out that here we are... Just standing around at a college party...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're a gorgeous sorority girl... I'm a charming and roguish stranger...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Are... Are you trying to get me to make out with you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Am I succeeding?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Kind of... But only if you keep the mustache on!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Deal!
Now that's what we call a perfect ending! Congrats!
